**Tenure/timeline notes:** The blank 2017-2020 entries and the gap in program-level (vs. solo-practice) clinical work since 2021 are worth a neutral, direct phone-screen question about the shape of her last five years — not a conclusion about why.
**Recommendation:** Advance to phone screen, contingent on confirming active Florida licensure up front (non-negotiable) and getting a clear walkthrough of 2019-present.
